gloss: defaulting on a debt; skipping out on a bill

definitions.gloss: defaulting on a debt; non-payment; skipping out on a bill
definitions.explanation: The act of deliberately failing to pay a debt, loan, or bill. Implies intentional avoidance of payment rather than inability to pay.

examples.japanese: {借金|しゃっきん}の{踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}しは{犯罪|はんざい}だ。
examples.english: Defaulting on a debt is a crime.

examples.japanese: {飲食代|いんしょくだい}の{踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}しで{捕|つか}まった。
examples.english: He was caught skipping out on a restaurant bill.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}の{踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}しが{続|つづ}いたため、{大家|おおや}さんが{訴訟|そしょう}を{起|お}こした。
examples.english: Because rent non-payment continued, the landlord filed a lawsuit.

notes:
USAGE:
Derived from the verb {踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}す (to default on, to skip out on). The noun form refers to the act itself. Carries a strongly negative connotation, implying deliberate dishonesty.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {借金|しゃっきん}の{踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}し (defaulting on a debt)
- {家賃|やちん}の{踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}し (rent non-payment)
- {踏|ふ}み{倒|たお}しをする (to default, to skip out on payment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {未払|みはら}い: non-payment, unpaid (more neutral, may be unintentional)
- {滞納|たいのう}: delinquency, arrears (formal administrative term)
- {食|く}い{逃|に}げ: dine and dash (specific to restaurants)
